body.statement: With the convention \(\operatorname{Bell}(0)=1\), the residual-state complexity is \(\rho(h)=\operatorname{Bell}(h-1)\) for every \(h\geq1\).  More precisely, for a fixed factual cell \(v\) and layer \(i\), the block of \(\pi_i\) containing the factual context is determined by \(v\) and \(\mathcal H\); restricting \(\pi_i\) to the remaining contexts is therefore an exact state and gives at most \(\operatorname{Bell}(h-1)\) states.  The single-conjunction compiler \(\mathsf C_1\) consequently runs in \(\operatorname{Bell}(h-1)3^{(h-1)/3}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}})\) time.  Conversely, for every \(h\), one binary instance on the complete-predecessor carrier \(\mathfrak F\) and one factual cell have \(\operatorname{Bell}(h-1)\) reachable prefix partitions that are pairwise distinguished under the residual equivalence by legal terminal normalized conjunctions \(\gamma^{\circ}\).  This is a state-count lower bound, not an \(h\log h\) time lower bound.
body.proof_tex:
Fix a cell \(v\) and a layer \(i\).  For a context \(w\in\mathcal H\), define
\[
 A_i(v)=\bigl\{w\in\mathcal H:
 w(t)=v_t\text{ for every }t\leq i\text{ in }\operatorname{dom}(w)\bigr\}.
\]
The factual context belongs to \(A_i(v)\), so this set is nonempty.  We claim that it is exactly the block of \(\pi_i\) containing the factual context, for every feasible prefix in \(F_v\).  If \(w\in A_i(v)\), induction on \(t\leq i\) gives \(E(f,w)_t=v_t\): an intervened coordinate equals \(v_t\) by definition of \(A_i(v)\), while a natural coordinate sees the factual predecessor tuple and hence equals \(f_t(v_{<t})=v_t\).  If \(w\notin A_i(v)\), at its first disagreeing intervened coordinate \(t\leq i\),
\[
 E(f,w)_t=w(t)\neq v_t=E(f,\varnothing)_t,
\]
so its complete prefix is not factual.  This proves the claim.

The set \(A_i(v)\) is computable from the input and the cell and does not depend on the partial response rows.  Every reachable \(\pi_i\) is consequently reconstructed from its restriction to \(\mathcal H\setminus A_i(v)\) by adjoining the single known block \(A_i(v)\).  Since \texttt{thm:partition-continuation} uses only the reconstructed partition, this restriction is an exact continuation state.  The number of such restricted partitions is at most
\[
 \operatorname{Bell}(|\mathcal H\setminus A_i(v)|)
 \leq\operatorname{Bell}(h-1).
\]
The inequality is elementary: extend any partition of a set of size at most \(h-1\) to a partition of an \((h-1)\)-element set by adjoining each new element as a singleton; this is an injection.
Replacing the \(B_h\) state count in the proof of \texttt{thm:single-conjunction-compiler} by this bound, while leaving its representative-transition bound unchanged, gives
\[
 \operatorname{Bell}(h-1)3^{(h-1)/3}
 \operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}).
\]

We prove that no uniformly smaller exact residual state space is possible.  Put \(m=h-1\), label the nonfactual contexts by \(J=\{1,\ldots,m\}\), and use binary variables ordered as
\[
 S\prec (Z_C)_{\varnothing\neq C\subsetneq J}\prec Y,
\]
in any fixed order among the \(Z_C\)'s.  When \(m\leq1\), the middle family is empty.  Let the factual cell be zero.  For \(j\in J\), define a context \(I_j\) by
\[
 I_j(S)=1,
 \qquad
 I_j(Z_C)=1\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad j\in C,
\]
with no other interventions.  The contexts are distinct, and together with \(\varnothing\) form a set of size \(h\).  After \(S\), the factual world is a singleton block and all contexts \(I_j\) share the prefix \((1)\).

Let \(\tau\) be any partition of \(J\).  We construct response rows whose partition after the last \(Z_C\) is
\[
 \{\{\varnothing\}\}\cup\tau.
\]
At the coordinate \(Z_C\), assign zero to the factual row.  On each currently natural nonfactual predecessor tuple, assign zero if \(C\) is a block of \(\tau\), and assign one otherwise.  If \(C\) is not a block of \(\tau\), all intervened worlds and all natural worlds in any current nonfactual block then append one, so no such block splits.  If \(C\) is a block of \(\tau\), the worlds in \(C\) append the intervention value one and all other natural nonfactual worlds append zero; thus \(C\) is split from any current block containing it.  Previously separated blocks never merge.  After the coordinates indexed by all blocks of \(\tau\) have appeared, and hence at the end of the middle family, the partition is exactly \(\{\{\varnothing\}\}\cup\tau\).  Distinct current blocks call distinct complete-predecessor rows, so every prescription is consistent and extends by defaults.  Thus all \(\operatorname{Bell}(m)\) such partitions are reachable in the same context system and factual cell.

Finally take distinct partitions \(\tau\) and \(\sigma\) of \(J\).  There is an orientation \((\alpha,\beta)\) of this pair and a map \(q:J\to\{0,1\}\) that is constant on every block of \(\alpha\) but nonconstant on some block of \(\beta\).  To see this, if \(\beta\) is not a refinement of \(\alpha\), choose a \(\beta\)-block meeting two \(\alpha\)-blocks and assign different binary values to those two \(\alpha\)-blocks; if \(\beta\) is a proper refinement of \(\alpha\), reverse their roles.  Set \(q(\varnothing)=0\) and use the predecessor-normal terminal conjunction
\[
 \gamma_q^{\circ}
 =\{Y_{\varnothing}=0\}
 \wedge\bigwedge_{j\in J}\{Y_{I_j}=q(j)\}.
\]
All its contexts occur explicitly and none intervenes on \(Y\).  From the prefix with partition \(\{\{\varnothing\}\}\cup\alpha\), assign the natural \(Y\)-row of each block its common required value, so the conjunction is feasible.  From the prefix with partition \(\{\{\varnothing\}\}\cup\beta\), two worlds in one block require different values, but they call the same \(Y\)-row, so the conjunction is infeasible.  Hence the \(\operatorname{Bell}(m)\) reachable prefixes are pairwise distinct residuals under \texttt{def:residual-minimality-handle}.  Combining this lower bound with the preceding upper bound proves \(\rho(h)=\operatorname{Bell}(h-1)\), including \(h=1\), where the complement of the factual block is empty and has one partition.  The argument counts necessary exact states only and makes no assertion that an implementation must spend time proportional to their explicit enumeration.
body.justification: The factual cell makes one partition block deterministic, and the remaining context partitions are both sufficient and jointly realizable in the worst case.
body.gap: This resolves the causal residual count without promoting a state lower bound into a time lower bound.
body.consumer: The single-conjunction compiler may replace its Bell number state factor by the exact one-smaller-context Bell number.
